_comment: Basic multi-host aggregation: list every machine's server_guard.db this operator can reach over an existing file share or mapped drive. Copy to config/hosts.json and fill in real paths -- e.g. a UNC path like \\RECEPTION-PC\c$\server-guard\server_guard.db, or a local path if generating the report on the same machine one of the DBs lives on. Each host runs its own independent guard.py -- this file only tells generate_fleet_report.py where to go look, it does not change how any host collects or stores its own data.
